flags.summary: The party has seen the hanged Vistana (Nicu) on the gallows at the Ivlis crossroads. Starts the_hanged_vistana.
The party has made its one attempt to examine the hanged man (Medicine).
The party took Nicu's silver horse's-head earring from the body, to bring to his people.
The party cut Nicu down from the gallows (or gathered his remains) and buried him by the road; he will not rise.
Rites were said over Nicu's grave (a cleric, or a Religion check).
Nicu and the old hanged dead of the gallows field rose at night and were destroyed (encounter crossroads_hanged_dead).
Ireena (as a guest) has remarked on the crossroads signpost; plays once.
Stanimir has welcomed the party to the Tser Pool camp.
The party shared Stanimir's plum wine.
Stanimir told the party the story of the prince, his brother and the bride (Strahd, Sergei, Tatyana).
The party has made its one Insight attempt on whom the Vistani answer to.
Grateful for news of Nicu, Stanimir will tell the castle the party went east. Later regions may soften Strahd's spies' reports.
The party opened Stanimir's strongbox at Tser Pool (container flag).
The party gave back the forty gold taken from Stanimir's strongbox.
The party lied its way out of the strongbox theft; Stanimir blames his own people. Madam Eva knows.
The party drew steel on Madam Eva and chose to fight the camp; the Vistani wait outside her tent (encounter tser_pool_ambush).
The party fought the Tser Pool Vistani and won; Stanimir and Luminita are gone, the camp is empty. Later regions: Vistani across Barovia hear of it.
The party has spoken with Luminita in the horse pen.
Luminita admitted the mare Nicu sold in Vallaki was one she found loose with a Vallaki brand.
The party told Luminita or Stanimir what became of Nicu (quest the_hanged_vistana told). The Tser Pool Vistani are grateful; Madam Eva reads for free.
The party has met Madam Eva in her tent.
Madam Eva greeted Ireena as someone who has 'come round again' (Tatyana's soul). Later regions may read it.
Madam Eva refused to read for free; the Persuasion option is gone.
The party threatened Madam Eva in her tent (Intimidation).
How the Tarokka reading was paid: coin, truth, free (Persuasion), kin (news of Nicu) or forced (threat, theft or the brawl). Later regions (Vallaki's Vistani) may read it.
Who paid Madam Eva with a secret: ilse_varga, hedda_ironvow, silvain_aster, tamsin_tealeaf, or other. The party heard it.
Madam Eva has read the Tarokka for the party; the five quests are foretold.
The Diviner was drawn for a treasure, and Madam Eva handed it over from her chest (the item itself waits on an engine need).
The party's one question after the reading: ireena, escape, weakness, kestrel, locket, dawn, aurel, why or none. Later regions may pay it off.
At Tser Falls, Ireena remembered a fall that wasn't hers (Tatyana). Later regions (Krezk, the castle) may read it.
The party killed the werewolf waiting at the lip of Tser Falls at night (encounter falls_werewolf).
How the party met Strahd riding on the road: defiant, courteous, shield, violent or silent. Later Strahd scenes may read it.
The party met Bogdan's funeral cart on the road (event, once).
The party looked at Bogdan's mother in her coffin (a Medicine check or a cleric's blessing).
The bitten old woman in the coffin: staked, warned (rushed to the church), unwarned (the party saw the marks and said nothing) or unknown. Phase 5 may raise her in the village churchyard.
The party met the procession of the dead on the road at night (event, once).
A cleric turned the dead procession back to its graves.
The party destroyed the dead procession (encounter road_dead_procession).
A raven walked beside the party on the road (event, once).
The party has made its one Nature check on the raven.
The party fed the raven; the Keepers of the Feather (Wizard of Wines, Phase 5) know them as friends.
The party struck the raven down; the Keepers of the Feather (Phase 5) remember.
The party met Grigor's wolf hunters in the Svalich Woods (event, once).
The party has made its one Insight check on the hunters.
Grigor's hunters took the party for friends and shared news of the windmill and the werewolves.
The party fought Grigor's hunters on the road (encounter road_hunters).
The party has heard of, or found the marks of, werewolves in the hills above Lake Zarovich (Phase 5 Werewolf Den).
The party found the lost peddler's pack on the road (event, once).
The party has made its one Survival check on the peddler's drag marks.
Madam Eva caught the party lying about Stanimir's strongbox (madam_eva: robbed). The free reading owed for bringing Nicu home is cancelled; they pay like strangers.
